items.q: What should you remember about **Caching is automatic** in Claude Code and Claude?
items.a: **no setup required; understanding it protects subscription limits.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Cache create vs cache read**?
items.a: **create is one-time write cost;** read is 10× cheaper reuse (system prompt, tools, CLAUDE.md, prior turns).

items.q: What should you remember about **Three layers**?
items.a: **system (instructions, tools, output style),** project (CLAUDE.md, memory, rules), conversation (messages/replies that grow each turn).

items.q: What should you remember about **Prefix matching**?
items.a: **cache keys on content prefix;** model switch = new prefix = zero cache hits on identical history.

items.q: What should you remember about **TTL by context**?
items.a: Claude Code on subscription: **1 hour** idle; API default: **5 minutes** (extendable to 1 hour at extra cost); sub-agents: **5 minutes** on any plan; extra-usage (post weekly limit) drops to 5 minutes on subscription too.

items.q: What should you remember about **Community TTL panic was unfounded**?
items.a: **Anthropic did not silently change subscription TTL from** 1 hour to 5 minutes; confusion came from API vs Code vs sub-agent docs being mixed.

items.q: What should you remember about **Anthropic monitors cache hit rate**?
items.a: **Thariq Shihipar (Anthropic)**: they run alerts and declare SEVs if Claude Code cache hit rates drop too low.

items.q: What should you remember about **Model switch breaks cache**?
items.a: including **Opus plan mode** (Opus in plan, Sonnet in execution): each plan toggle is a model switch and fresh cache; still saves limits long-run but resets cache each toggle.

items.q: What should you remember about **Edit CLAUDE.md mid-session is safe**?
items.a: **changes don't apply until** session restart, so cache stays intact.

items.q: What should you remember about **Session handoff at ~205K tokens**?
items.a: **Nate demo**: summarize → /copy → /clear → paste; faster than /compact (which also breaks cache).

items.q: What should you remember about **Token dashboard**?
items.a: **local GitHub repo reads past Claude Code** session files; device-specific; setup by giving repo link to Claude Code for localhost install.
